# Step K4: big pictures in a B-roll list made lighter when it is saved

Lex (2026-10-29), asked whether the script editor would also shrink "a B-roll list file made somewhere else that already contains big pictures, which you then link in the editor", the next time it saves that list: "Yes".

## What changes

- **Every save of a B-roll list** (a Keep, a shot added, changed or removed, an Undo, a sketch, "Save as…") first makes its big pictures lighter, the same way as pictures from an agent (step K3): cut to the storyboard frame, at most 640 × 345, WebP (JPEG where the browser can't make WebP), about 60 KB. All in the person's browser.
- **Big** means over `PICTURE_BUDGET` (80,000 characters as a data address, about 60 KB): pictures in a list made elsewhere, and pictures kept before step K3 (up to 960 × 720 JPEG). Pictures over `IMAGE_MAX` (about 300 KB), which the editor doesn't show, are made lighter too, so they show again. A picture is read up to 8 million characters (about 6 MB); bigger ones, other formats (such as GIF), small pictures, line drawings and picture lines inside code fences (examples) stay as they are. A picture that can't be read stays as it is.
- **Made once.** A big picture takes its lighter version only when that is at least 10% smaller (`worthLighter`): a picture the editor made can't get that much smaller again, so it is never made again and loses nothing more on later saves. Two smaller last steps (0.4 at 0.35 and 0.35 at ¼ size) let even a very busy picture fit the budget. (A picture just over the budget that can't get 10% smaller is still tried on each save, and the try is dropped: nothing is lost, it only takes a moment.)
- **Safe while it works.** Making pictures lighter takes a moment; every save (also a sketch Keep waiting behind it, and "Save as…") remembers which list it was made for and checks before and after that the same list is still open, so a script or list opened meanwhile is never written. Where the list lives is read when the save's turn comes, so a "Save as…" or a rename of the same list before it is followed.
- Linking a list writes nothing, so nothing changes until the list is saved.
- What shows follows the saved list at once.

## Checks

`tests/broll.test.mjs` (`bigPictures`: small, big, too big to show, other formats, line drawings, CRLF, code fences, the edges at the budget and at 8 million; `worthLighter`). In a real browser (headless Chrome, local Worker, MCP over fetch): a list kept in the browser with a big picture, one too big to show, a small one and a line drawing; a Keep saves it with both big ones made lighter (WebP, within the budget), the one too big now showing, the small one and the line drawing unchanged; "Save as…" writes a lighter file; a list file linked from disk (picker stubbed) gets lighter on a sketch Keep; a picture that can't be read stays; a busy picture over the budget is not made again on the next save (the file stays byte for byte); opening another script while a slow save makes pictures lighter leaves that script's list untouched, also with a sketch Keep waiting behind the slow save, and "Save as…" during it never puts the other script's list in the picked file (it stays empty); a sketch Keep waiting behind "Save as…" lands in the new file (checked strictly); a rename by title while a Keep waits puts the sketch and the new shot under the new name, the old one gone. The run is in `docs/agents/evidence/step-k4-browser.txt`.
